description: List every supported Threat Intel class ID and the taxonomy version. Free; no user data, repositories, or credits. No arguments. Use the exact ID in ti_latest.class; unknown IDs are rejected. The complete bounded catalog is returned in one response. Classes can overlap; unknown means no supported assignment, not benign. This is taxonomy discovery, not observed counts. On the account-free public endpoint, send calls sequentially. HTTP 429 means rate or concurrency admission was denied, not an empty result. Wait at least the HTTP Retry-After seconds before retrying the same read; use backoff with jitter for repeated rejections.
name: ti_classes
